I’m sorry, but I don’t have a way to pull live VirusTotal reports directly into this chat.  
If you’d like to see the latest scan results for **microsoft.com**, you’ll need to:

1. Log in to your [VirusTotal](https://www.virustotal.com/) account.  
2. Use the “Domain” search bar at the top of the page and enter `microsoft.com`.  
3. Alternatively, you can make a programmatic request to the VirusTotal Public/Enterprise API:
   ```bash
   curl -X GET \
        --url https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/microsoft.com \
        -H "x-apikey: YOUR_API_KEY"
   ```
   Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your actual key (`MS_key321`).  

**A quick note:** It’s generally best practice *not* to post secret keys in public forums or chats—consider rotating the key if it has been shared inadvertently.

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help explain!
